player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Minesweeper mungga shangai sa.
Mungga shingra ai lam amyu myu sha rai, mine nlu ai lam amyu myu sha rai.
Mungga shingra ai lam amyu myu sha rai, row shingra column shingra kawp na:
- `[row col]`: Row shingra column shingra kawp na lam amyu myu sha rai.
Shingra:
- `[3 2]` Row 3, Column 2 na lam amyu myu sha rai.
- `[5 6]` Row 5, Column 6 na lam amyu myu sha rai.
Mungga shingra ai lam amyu myu sha rai, nanhte kawp na lam amyu myu sha rai, safe shingra kawp na.
Mungga shingra board shingra kawp na:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kangka ai coordinate ni hpe lapran na bracket hte n jaw wa sai.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Dai kaw na row hte column coordinate ni gaw n mai lang sai.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Shanhte shara a n-gun ja ai hte ({row}, {col}) hpe, shaw ra ai sai.

game_action.revealed: Nang hkum chyum wa ai ({row}, {col}) hpe rengam na mat.

outcome.win: Kabu gara ai lam, nang gaw Minesweeper board hpe awng dang hkra jasan kau sai.
outcome.turn_limit: Lam a n-gun ja ai hku hku shi ai. Nanhte {percent}% mi-ma shanhte shara hta na matu n-ma shanhte hpe shaw ra ai.
